# Naturally Artificial

> Naturally Artificial is a long-form video show of founder-to-founder talks in the AI era, hosted by Sergey Osipov — a founder turned investor. Founders, operators and investors talk about what AI is actually changing in the way companies are built, financed and run.

Key facts:

- Format: long-form video conversations, 30–60 minutes, one or two new episodes a month
- Language: mostly English; some episodes in Russian with English subtitles or English dubbing
- Host: Sergey Osipov — thirty years building his own companies, one of which became a unicorn; now an investor through Joox VC and Zubr Capital
- Watch: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Naturally_Artificial · Listen: Spotify https://open.spotify.com/show/033U1gDnjee2ValRcN3vWX · Read: Telegram https://t.me/naturally_artificial
- Contact: through the form on the contact page (guests, startup pitches, sponsorship, speaking, press)

## Pages

- [Naturally Artificial — founder-to-founder talks in the AI era](https://naturallyartificial.com/): A show where founders talk to founders about AI disruption, roll-ups, raising capital in the EU, tech hubs and relocation. Hosted by Sergey Osipov.
- [About Naturally Artificial — the show and every episode](https://naturallyartificial.com/show): What Naturally Artificial is, who it talks to, the numbers behind it, and every episode.
- [Sponsor Naturally Artificial — partnerships and advertising](https://naturallyartificial.com/sponsors): Who watches Naturally Artificial, the numbers, what a release gets across YouTube, Telegram, Instagram and LinkedIn, and how to partner with the show.
- [Be a guest on Naturally Artificial](https://naturallyartificial.com/guests): Who the show is looking for, what the conversation is like, what happens after it is released, and how to suggest yourself or someone else.
- [About Sergey Osipov — founder, investor, host and speaker](https://naturallyartificial.com/about): Founder turned investor. 30 years in his own startups, now backing others — mostly at the later stage, through Zubr Capital and Joox VC.
- [Press kit — Naturally Artificial](https://naturallyartificial.com/presskit): Press kit for Naturally Artificial: the show in a paragraph, current audience numbers, Sergey Osipov's bio, the logo and the brand guide.
- [Contact — Naturally Artificial](https://naturallyartificial.com/contact): Suggest a guest for Naturally Artificial, pitch a startup, ask about sponsorship and collaborations, invite Sergey Osipov to speak, or send a press enquiry.
- [Blog](https://naturallyartificial.com/blog/): every post from the Naturally Artificial Telegram channel, one page each

## Questions

- **What is Naturally Artificial?** A long-form video show of founder-to-founder talks in the AI era. Host Sergey Osipov talks with founders, operators and investors about what AI is actually changing in the way companies are built, financed and run
- **Who hosts the show?** Sergey Osipov, a founder turned investor. He spent thirty years building companies of his own, one of which became a unicorn, and now invests through Joox VC and Zubr Capital. More on his page
- **Where can I watch or listen?** On YouTube and Spotify. The notes between episodes go to Telegram and to the blog
- **How often do new episodes come out?** One or two a month. Each runs 30 to 60 minutes
- **What language is the show in?** Mostly English. Some episodes are in Russian, with English subtitles or English dubbing
- **How can I become a guest?** Suggest yourself or someone else through the contact form. What the show looks for is on the guest page
- **How can a company sponsor the show?** Through sponsorship of the show, an info-partnership or a joint format. The options and the audience are on the sponsor page
- **Where are the logo and press materials?** In the press kit: the show in a paragraph, current numbers, the host's bio, the logo and the brand guide
